phone.$description: Narrow phones are under it. GB max-width 30rem. Custom properties do not work in media queries: write the literal with a /* breakpoint.phone */ comment, or use dist/css/custom-media.css.

tablet.$description: Phones are under it (768px): GB draws the phone home screen below 767.98px.

desktop.$description: Desktop layouts start here (1100px): GB stacks the hero to one column below it.
